chapter_seo_title: Han Li's Desperate Bargain: The Jade Phoenix Marrow Body in Chapter 596
chapter_meta_description: Stranded in the Netherworld Domain with no mana, Han Li must weigh a risky deal with Mei Ning, who offers a rare Spirit Essence Qi in exchange for escape and a search for her missing brother.
og_title: Spirit Essence Pact: Han Li's Netherworld Bargain
og_description: A rare cultivation physique offers a sliver of hope, but the price is a promise Han Li isn't sure he can keep.
twitter_title: The Jade Phoenix Marrow Body: Han Li's Only Way Out?
twitter_description: No mana, no escape, no easy choices. Mei Ning's secret might be Han Li's ticket out, but the catch is steep.

lore_anchors.definition: One of the seven great pure essences of the cultivation world, capable of cleansing a male cultivator's meridians and boosting cultivation, but only transferable with a woman's willing consent and only once in her life.

A special female physique that generates a single thread of Spirit Essence Qi upon reaching Foundation Establishment; it is highly sought after but is lost if the woman loses her virginity before transferring it.
The only known escape route from the Netherworld Domain, a treacherous peak covered in Yin winds, illusionary fog, and hostile flying Yin Beasts.
A traditional Chinese cultural marker applied to a woman's arm to indicate virginity; in xianxia, it is often used as a litmus test for special spiritual constitutions tied to purity.
A desolate, mana-sealed realm in the Chaotic Star Sea where cultivators are trapped with no way to recover their power, born from a massive Spirit Void Eruption.
A class of creature born from concentrated Yin energy or Netherworld force, often found in sealed, dark realms; they are vulnerable to Yang-aligned or ghost-suppressing techniques.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Spirit Essence Qi?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is one of the seven great pure essences, a rare energy a woman with the Jade Phoenix Marrow Body can transfer to a male cultivator once in her life to cleanse his meridians and boost his cultivation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't Han Li just take Mei Ning with him?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He has no mana and can barely protect himself; bringing her along would likely get both of them killed on the treacherous Stormwind Mountain.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Jade Phoenix Marrow Body?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a special female physique that, upon reaching Foundation Establishment, generates a single thread of Spirit Essence Qi that can only be given willingly to one man in her life.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Mei Ning trust Han Li so easily?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She has observed his character and believes he is a man of his word; she feels a poisonous oath is unnecessary, which is a rare sign of genuine trust in the Mortal Stream.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the three-month deadline about?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Han Li has personal reasons to leave the Netherworld Domain quickly and can only promise to search for Mei Ning's brother for three months before he must depart.
